meta.description: Public CLI Registry — Third-party and official CLIs managed by CLI-Hub across npm, bundled, brew, and other install methods

clis.name: feishu
clis.description: Official Lark (Feishu) CLI for managing Lark apps, bots, and cloud resources from the terminal
clis.requires: Node.js >= 16

clis.name: minimax-cli
clis.description: MiniMax AI platform CLI for managing tokens, models, and API interactions from the command line
clis.requires: Node.js >= 16, MINIMAX_API_KEY

clis.name: wecom
clis.description: Official WeCom open-platform CLI for contacts, todos, meetings, messages, calendars, docs, and smart sheets
clis.requires: Node.js >= 18, WeCom account (currently limited rollout), optional Bot ID + Secret for bot flows

clis.name: x-twitter-scraper
clis.description: CLI for Twitter search, profile and follower exports, monitoring, webhooks, and approved X actions through Xquik. Not affiliated with X Corp.
clis.requires: Go 1.26.6+ or automatic Go toolchain downloads; Xquik API key or OAuth bearer token for API requests
clis.update_notes: Install a newer tagged release after reviewing its release notes.
clis.uninstall_notes: Remove x-twitter-scraper from the directory reported by go env GOBIN or GOPATH/bin.

clis.name: contentful
clis.description: Official Contentful CLI for spaces, migrations, imports, exports, seeding, and environment management
clis.requires: Node.js LTS, Contentful account and space access

clis.name: sanity
clis.description: Official Sanity CLI for studios, datasets, schemas, imports, exports, and structured content workflows
clis.requires: Node.js and npm, Sanity account/project access

clis.name: shopify
clis.description: Official Shopify CLI for apps, themes, functions, extensions, and Hydrogen storefront workflows
clis.requires: Node.js and npm, Shopify Partner/store access

clis.name: sentry
clis.description: Official Sentry CLI for releases, sourcemaps, debug files, monitors, and org/project automation
clis.requires: Sentry account plus auth token/org/project access for most operations

clis.name: 1password-cli
clis.description: Official 1Password CLI for vault access, secrets retrieval, item automation, and desktop-app-backed authentication
clis.requires: 1Password account; desktop app integration recommended for biometric/system-auth sign-in

clis.name: android-cli
clis.description: Official Android terminal interface for SDK setup, project creation, emulator/device management, app run/deploy workflows, docs access, and skill management for any agent
clis.requires: Preview release; Linux x86_64, macOS arm64, or Windows x86_64. Android SDK / JDK requirements depend on the workflow you run.
clis.install_notes: Install Android CLI from the official archive page: Linux `curl -fsSL https://dl.google.com/android/cli/latest/linux_x86_64/install.sh | bash`; macOS `curl -fsSL https://dl.google.com/android/cli/latest/darwin_arm64/install.sh | bash`; Windows `curl.exe -fsSL https://dl.google.com/android/cli/latest/windows_x86_64/install.cmd -o "%TEMP%\i.cmd" && "%TEMP%\i.cmd"`.
clis.uninstall_notes: Remove the Android CLI binary from your PATH or rerun the official installer cleanup flow for your platform.
clis.update_notes: Run `android update` to fetch the latest Android CLI capabilities, or reinstall from the official archive page if needed.

clis.name: generate-veo-video
clis.description: CLI for generating videos with Google Veo 3.1 via Vertex AI/Gemini — text-to-video, image-to-video, reference images, frame morphing, and video extension
clis.requires: Python >= 3.10, uv, GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT env var (GEMINI_API_KEY optional)

clis.name: suno
clis.description: CLI for generating music with Suno AI from lyrics and style prompts, with batch generation, status polling, downloads, and automatic MP3 tagging
clis.requires: Python 3 and a Suno API key from sunoapi.org

clis.name: elevenlabs
clis.description: Official ElevenLabs CLI for managing voice agents as code with local configs, templates, auth, push/pull sync, tests, widgets, and branch-aware workflows
clis.requires: Node.js and npm, ELEVENLABS_API_KEY or interactive login

clis.name: jimeng
clis.description: Official ByteDance AI image and video generation CLI — text-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video, digital human, and intelligent canvas; domestic brand is Jimeng (即梦), international brand is Dreamina
clis.requires: Jimeng / Dreamina account and API key

clis.name: obsidian-cli
clis.description: Official Obsidian command line interface for vault automation, developer tools, screenshots, search, history, and plugin workflows
clis.requires: Obsidian 1.12.7+ installer, Obsidian desktop app running, and Command line interface enabled in Settings → General
clis.install_notes: Bundled within the Obsidian 1.12+ installer. Enable Command line interface in Obsidian settings and follow the registration prompt so `obsidian` is added to PATH.
clis.uninstall_notes: Disable Command line interface from Obsidian settings or remove/update the Obsidian installer to stop using the bundled CLI.
clis.update_notes: Update the Obsidian installer to a newer 1.12+ release to update the bundled CLI.

clis.name: py4csr
clis.description: GxP-compliant agent harness for CDISC Clinical Study Report (CSR) and Tables/Figures/Listings (TFL) generation
clis.requires: Python >= 3.10

clis.name: deployhq
clis.description: Deploy code, manage projects/servers, run and monitor deployments via the DeployHQ platform — for humans and AI agents
clis.requires: DeployHQ account (free tier available); Homebrew for the default install path

clis.name: obsidian-agent-cli
clis.description: Full-featured CLI for Obsidian — manage notes, canvases, Excalidraw diagrams, Kanban boards, periodic notes, git, tasks, and more. Includes an AI agent skill for persistent knowledge capture and project memory.
clis.requires: Obsidian desktop app, Local REST API community plugin

clis.name: arcgis-pro
clis.description: Agent-native CLI for ArcGIS Pro (ArcPy): professional cartography (layouts + map series), geoprocessing, and feature query/edit — plus a live-Pro MCP bridge that drives the open session.
clis.requires: Windows only — ArcGIS Pro is Windows-only. Needs a licensed ArcGIS Pro install with ArcPy (its bundled arcgispro-py3 Python); the optional live-Pro MCP bridge additionally needs the .NET 8 SDK.

clis.name: cloakbrowser
clis.description: Agent-friendly CLI for CloakBrowser — stealth Chromium that passes every bot detection test. Covers fingerprint flags, humanize behaviors, page operations, content extraction, cookies, storage, network, multi-page sessions, and CDP gateway.
clis.requires: Node.js >= 20, cloakbrowser >= 0.3.0, playwright-core >= 1.40.0

clis.name: smithue-cli
clis.description: CLI tool for controlling Unreal Engine editor via SmithUE plugin. Enables AI agents to execute editor commands, list tools, search capabilities, and monitor editor status.
clis.requires: Node.js >=18; Unreal Engine with SmithUE plugin running (Windows only)

clis.name: browser-cdp
clis.description: Browser automation via raw Chrome DevTools Protocol — connects to YOUR existing Chrome, no extensions, no new browser, inherits all cookies and sessions
clis.requires: Chrome/Chromium with --remote-debugging-port=9222, Python >= 3.10

clis.name: pieces
clis.description: Agent-native CLI for Pieces OS — persistent long-term memory for developers. Search, create, and manage memory assets, snippets, and models via Pieces OS REST API.
clis.requires: Pieces OS running locally (http://localhost:39300)

clis.name: vivideo
clis.description: Vivideo AI video generation CLI — create avatar and text-to-video content from the terminal, scripts, CI, or agents. Supports auto and manual modes, model/avatar/voice/brand-kit listing, credit estimates, and status/wait polling.
clis.requires: Node.js >= 18.17, VIVIDEO_API_KEY

clis.name: wirecat-telegram
clis.description: Read, search and send in your personal Telegram account from the terminal or an MCP server. Chats sync to a local store, so search works offline
clis.requires: Node.js >= 22.19, a Telegram account

clis.name: wirecat-max
clis.description: Read and send in MAX Messenger from the terminal, through the official Bot API or your personal account. Local search and an MCP server
clis.requires: Node.js >= 22.16, a MAX account or a MAX bot token

clis.name: wirecat-whatsapp
clis.description: Read, search and send in your personal WhatsApp account from the terminal, linked as a device. Local search and an MCP server
clis.requires: Node.js >= 22.16, a WhatsApp account linked as a device

clis.name: wirecat-zoom
clis.description: Keep your Zoom cloud recordings and transcripts in a local archive, search them and schedule meetings from the terminal or an MCP server
clis.requires: Node.js >= 22.16, a Zoom account

clis.name: wirecat-mail
clis.description: Sync an IMAP mailbox to a local store and search it offline, sort mail on the server with undo, and write, send and reply over SMTP. The password stays in the OS keyring
clis.requires: Node.js >= 22.16, an IMAP mailbox

clis.name: wirecat-google-drive
clis.description: Search and read the Google Drive folders you choose offline, with Docs, Sheets, PDF and docx as local text, from the terminal or an MCP server
clis.requires: Node.js >= 22.16, a Google account

clis.name: wirecat-google-calendar
clis.description: Sync, search and change Google Calendar events and check free/busy time from the terminal or an MCP server
clis.requires: Node.js >= 22.16, a Google account

clis.name: wirecat-notion
clis.description: Search a synced copy of your Notion pages offline, read a page as Markdown live and list databases, with your own token, from the terminal or an MCP server
clis.requires: Node.js >= 22.16, a Notion account

clis.name: wirecat-yandex-disk
clis.description: Search and read your Yandex Disk files, and download, upload, move or share them, from the terminal or an MCP server
clis.requires: Node.js >= 22.16, a Yandex account

clis.name: wirecat-memo
clis.description: Context about a person across your messengers, notes and mail, from one local store. Ask who someone is and what you talked about
clis.requires: Node.js >= 22.16, at least one other WireCat CLI synced

clis.name: wirecat-hubspot
clis.description: Keep a local copy of HubSpot deals, contacts and companies, change deals and contacts, and call any HubSpot CRM API operation from the terminal or an MCP server
clis.requires: Node.js >= 22.16, a HubSpot account

clis.name: wirecat-bitrix24
clis.description: Read and change Bitrix24 CRM deals, leads, contacts and companies from the terminal or an MCP server, with a local copy for search
clis.requires: Node.js >= 22.16, a Bitrix24 portal

clis.name: wirecat-asterisk
clis.description: Turn Asterisk PBX calls and recordings into searchable meetings, transcribed on your own computer. Read-only
clis.requires: Node.js >= 22.16, an Asterisk PBX with CDR (Master.csv, MySQL or PostgreSQL)

clis.name: wirecat-beeline
clis.description: Sync Beeline Cloud PBX call records, transcribe the calls on your own computer, then search and export them
clis.requires: Node.js >= 22.16, a Beeline Cloud PBX account
